description: Prices a payin from a local payment method into a stablecoin wallet. Send one of wallet_id (BlindPay-managed wallet) or blockchain_wallet_id. Do not send a network: the wallet decides where the tokens are delivered. request_amount is in cents; the minimum depends on the currency (1000, which is 10.00, for USD and BRL) and OTC quotes have a higher minimum. funding_bank_account_id is required when payment_method is ach_pull. The quote expires 5 minutes after creation, or 10 seconds for OTC quotes; create the payin with Create Payin before then.

Idempotency-Key.description: Optional key to safely retry this request without performing the action twice. Retrying with the same key and an identical body replays the original response; reusing a key with a different body returns an error. Keys are kept for 24 hours.

cover_fees.description: If true, the sender will cover the fees. If false, the customer will cover the fees.

funding_bank_account_id.description: Plaid-connected bank account that funds the payin by ach pull. Required when payment_method is ach_pull, not accepted otherwise.

is_otc.description: If true, the payin quote is for an OTC (Over the Counter) transaction
